item.description: Publisher DreadXP and developer Lovely Hellplace announced a release date for Dread Delusion on consoles. Their open-world retro RPG is coming to Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PS5 on March 17th.

item.description: Moonlighter and Cataclismo developer Digital Sun has announced ReVamped, a new "Tower Defensevania" game where you build up Dracula's castle room by room with an army of monsters.

item.title: 2.5D anime-styled roguelike platformer SlashZero announced
item.description: Indie developer Streetlamp Studio has announced SlashZero, a new 2.5D anime-styled roguelike platformer. SlashZero is in development for Windows PC (via Steam and the Epic Games Store) and PS5.
